end.summary:
Aarav ordered BCE and CE dates correctly on a timeline, including that larger BCE numbers are earlier.
They correctly used decade, century and millennium, and identified 1947 as 20th century.
They correctly calculated differences between dates in three attempts.
They needed support to identify historical sources and what each source can tell us; source teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised timelines, date calculations, time units, and historical sources with Aarav. Aarav used the BCE timeline and subtraction method correctly. They first treated books as the main source and mixed up pottery with inscriptions; this was corrected by the final turn, when they distinguished a pot from an inscription and explained that inscriptions may give a ruler’s name or other information. At home, practise sorting examples such as coins, pots, inscriptions, books, and oral traditions into source types and saying what each can show.
